title: King Zedekiah and Jeremiah
description: King Zedekiah secretly sends for the prophet Jeremiah to ask about the city's fate. Jeremiah delivers the Lord's message: if he surrenders to the officials of Babylon's king, he and his household will live, and the city will be spared. But if he refuses, Jerusalem will be burned down, his wives and children taken away by the Chaldeans, and he himself captured by Babylon's king [ref:Jer 38:14-23|Jeremiah 38:14-23].
